newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent closes touch higher on pre-API buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent closes touch higher on pre-API buying.

text.p: IPE September Brent futures closed a few cents firmer on Tuesday after last minute buying ahead of the release of API data pushed the contract out of the day's narrow range.
September Brent closed at $19.54 a barrel, up eight cents on the day and just four cents off the days high of $19.58 which was reached just before the close.
Dealers said there was little chance of testing initial resistance of $19.64 since Brent had been trading within a tight range for much of the day.
"It is pre-API buying, no one is short here," said one IPE floor trader.

American Petroluem Institute oil data stocks will be released later on Tuesday. They are expected to show a rise of two to three million barrels in crude stocks, but more importantly a draw for the sixth consecutive week in gasoline - the current market driver.
Gasoline stocks are seen droppng between one and two million barrels, bringing total gasoline supply near an histroical low of 190 million barrels.
August gas oil closed $4.00 a tonne stronger at $176.00, playing catch-up to Brent's late Monday gains.
The market continued to wait for fresh news on the re-emergence of Iraqi oil on world markets to give real direction.
U.N. overseers are expecting Iraq's pricing formula for the second round of oil-for-food sales sometime today, an official said on Tuesday.
Assuming there were no objections, approval should take two days once the U.N. receives the formula, the overseer said.
